training_objective.J_host: P.j_value L169-170: J = mean_P(T - T^2/2) + mean_Q(-T - T^2/2) = E_P T - E_Q T - 1/2 E_P T^2 - 1/2 E_Q T^2
training_objective.vcs: loss = -J(tanh f_P, tanh f_Q) (P.loss_fn L174-175): bounded by an output tanh on an MLP critic
training_objective.P_Q_coefficients: P: +1 T, -1/2 T^2; Q: -1 T, -1/2 T^2 (same as package J)
training_objective.scene_weights: implicit equal 1/n_sc: .mean() over the flattened [n_sc, n_pos] tensors with equal n_pos = 128 per scene; positions 1/n_pos
training_objective.sign: training minimises -J (vcs); registration maximises F (J for critics and kernel, MI, NMI, -MSE for CoMIR)
training_objective.optimiser: AdamW(lr 1e-3, weight_decay 1e-4, default betas / eps) over eU + eV + critic jointly (G L144-145); clip_grad_norm_(all params, 1.0) (G L173); 3000 steps (smoke 200); no LR schedule; checkpoint every 250 steps
training_objective.amp: none: no autocast / GradScaler / half / bfloat16 anywhere in src/v9/reg or scripts/v9/reg_*; float32 tensors
training_objective.regularisation: AdamW decoupled weight decay 1e-4 on all parameters incl. biases and critic; gradient-norm clipping 1.0; crop / rot90 / flip augmentation; no dropout, BatchNorm or ridge on the critic path
training_objective.comir: SGD lr 1e-2 momentum 0.9 weight_decay 1e-5 per network; L1 and L2 activation decay 1e-4; clip 1.0 per network; 23 epochs x 32 steps x 32 crops; p4 rot90 equivariance (G L192-221)
training_objective.kernel: closed form w = (A + 1e-3 mean(diag A) I)^-1 d, A = E_P psi psi^T + E_Q psi psi^T, d = E_P psi - E_Q psi, psi = sqrt(2/1024) cos(z W + b), T = w . psi (no tanh); bandwidth h = mult x median pairwise distance, mult in {0.5, 1, 2} selected on CAL (G.fit_kernel_g1 L237-253; Q L304-310)

geometry.perturbation: Q.perturb_map L86-90: V_p = V o T*^-1, V_p(y) = V(R(-theta*)(y - c - t*) + c); bilinear, reflection padding
geometry.units: theta in radians inside apply_T, degrees in perturbations.json and in result records; t in working px (512 grid)
geometry.pixel_convention: integer coordinates are pixel centres; normalised grid = (coord + 0.5) / size * 2 - 1 with align_corners=False (P.sample_map L162-166, Q.sample_pts L75-78)
geometry.padding: zeros in Q.sample_pts default (critic warps, MI / kernel / CoMIR sampling) and P.sample_map; reflection in Q.perturb_map (V_p creation) and comir_wte full-frame warps; by the support bound neither padding reaches a sampled value of the critic / MI / kernel energies
geometry.warp_order_critics: warp-then-encode (Q.RigidEnergy.batch L194-198): for every candidate the moving image is resampled onto BOX1 [110, 401]^2 (292 x 292) of the reference frame, encoded by eV, descriptors sampled at x - 110
geometry.grid_stage_critics: Q.RigidEnergy.grid_values L200-211: rotation-only warp of BOX2 [59, 452]^2 (394 x 394) encoded once per angle, translations applied as descriptor shifts R(-theta) t (translation-equivariance approximation; exact energies only in the refinement)
geometry.warp_order_comir: encode-once (Q L319-325, P3 L475-481): latents of V_p as given sampled at T(x); comir_wte (warp-then-encode) is a DEV-only sensitivity row
geometry.warp_order_kernel_mi: kernel: 9 x 9 patch offsets added in the reference frame then mapped by T (warp-then-extract, Q L164-167, L185-187); MI / NMI: intensities sampled at T(x) (Q L180-182)
geometry.support_visibility: fixed interior disk Omega, radius R_OMEGA = 129 about c (Q L54) shared by all methods; bound 129 + 16 sqrt2 + 51 + 51 + sqrt2 = 255.042 <= 255.5 so every sample (critic receptive field and bilinear neighbours included) stays inside V for all allowed (theta, t) and (theta*, t*); RF reach inside BOX1 local [0.5, 290.5] of [0, 291] and inside BOX2 local [0.5, 392.5] of [0, 393]; no visibility mask and no per-candidate support change

q_mode_audit.question: is the current G1 negative term the package's V mode (ordinary permutation incl. fixed points), and are there forbidden edges?
q_mode_audit.answer_reference: YES for the reference: Q is within-scene and built from an ordinary uniform permutation with fixed points allowed; its conditional expectation over the permutation is exactly the package V mode (all n^2 within-scene pairs incl. the diagonal, denominator n^2): E_pi[(1/n) sum_i g(a_i, b_pi(i))] = (1/n^2) sum_{i,j} g(a_i, b_j) for any pair function g
q_mode_audit.answer_estimator: the host evaluates ONE draw (perm1), not the V moments: training draws a fresh permutation per scene per step (G L157); registration keeps one permutation of 4096 for the whole search (Q L159). This is the package comparator sampled_permutation_terms / MLP_VCS_perm1, not product_moments / M0
q_mode_audit.forbidden_edges: none in any Q (training, registration, kernel fit). The only spatial exclusion in the host is the eps > 0 mismatch generator (>= 2 patch radii), which corrupts P and does not remove Q edges
q_mode_audit.infonce_and_comir: InfoNCE training uses the n x n within-scene matrix with diagonal targets (no Q permutation); CoMIR's NT-Xent masks only the self-similarity diagonal of its 2N latents (native, not a VCS Q)
q_mode_audit.target_change_needed: no change of reference: V mode = the host's conditional target. Recorded differences are listed under target_differences_vs_package; nothing was changed
